title: La griglia degli assi
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 3)
print(axs.shape, axs[1, 2] is axs.flat[5])
codeHtml: import matplotlib.pyplot as plt fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 3) print(axs.shape, axs[1, 2] is axs.flat[5])
explain: subplots(2, 3) restituisce un array 2×3 di assi. axs.flat li scorre riga per riga: l'ultimo, il sesto, è axs[1, 2].
